messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sometimes it is not safe to use certain medicines at the same time. Some drugs can affect your blood levels of other drugs you use, which may increase side effects or make the medicines less effective.
Other drugs may interact with amlodipine, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products. Tell your doctor about all other medicines you use.
Tell your doctor if you take simvastatin. You should not take more than 20 mg of simvastatin daily while taking amlodipine.
Triplet: ["amlodipine", "has drug interaction", "herbal products"]

The relation 'has drug interaction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may interact with the specified type of medication, potentially affecting its efficacy or increasing side effects.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has possible cause of inadequate effect': The specified condition or factor may contribute to the drug not achieving its intended therapeutic effect.
D. 'affected by': The subject drug's effect or behavior can be influenced or altered by the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
